subject: Hub & Huddle co-host series — MDF scope & calendar sync
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@scaleforge.com>, Jake Turner <jake.turner@scaleforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hub & Huddle co-host series — MDF scope & calendar sync

Hi Sarah / Jake —

Great to chat briefly at the Partner Summit last week. As discussed, ScaleForge + Redwood co-hosting a small series of hybrid "Hub & Huddle" sessions (short webinar + 1-day pop-up demo in three regional markets) feels like a high-conversion format for both our product teams. I wanted to put a concrete proposal on the table so we can line up budget and dates.

High level proposal:
- Program: 3 webinars (live, 45 min) + 3 one-day pop-up demo days (SF, NYC, Chicago) tied to each webinar.
- Target audience: Platform engineers and ML infra leads at mid-market / enterprise (50–200 attendees per webinar; 150–250 demo visitors per pop-up).
- KPIs: Registrations, qualified pipeline ($50k+), demo-to-opportunity conversion target 5–7%.
- MDF ask: Redwood proposes $35k per market (covers venue, local staffing, travel, local marketing); we can discuss scaling if ScaleForge splits costs.

Attachments: draft_mdf_agreement.pdf (initial terms), event_timetable.xlsx (high-level schedule).

As next steps: can ScaleForge confirm target KPIs, preferred dates in Apr–Jun window, and whether your demand gen team will run co-marketing emails? If we have a quick sync this week we can lock the MDF and calendar.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@scaleforge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Turner <jake.turner@scaleforge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hub & Huddle co-host series — MDF scope & calendar sync

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear proposal. We like the hybrid model; ScaleForge's events team thinks the SF/NYC/Chi mix makes sense. A few questions from our side:
1) Can you share how the $35k number breaks down (venue vs. staffing vs. ads)?
2) We usually ask for a minimum registration commitment and a lead-share cadence — can Redwood commit to passing MQLs within 48 hours?
3) Are you open to a 60/40 MDF split in the first market (ScaleForge 60%) and 50/50 for the subsequent markets?

We'd also want clarity on co-branded assets (email templates, landing page) and whether Redwood will own the webinar recording.

I'll attach a short checklist from our events ops that lists tracking and security requirements for vendor booths.

—Sarah
Sarah Mills
Director, Partnerships & Events
ScaleForge

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@scaleforge.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hub & Huddle co-host series — MDF scope & calendar sync

Sarah / Stephanie —

Quick context from revenue: our goal for the program is to generate three closed-won deals (average ACV $75–120k) across the three markets in the 90 days post-event. That drives our tolerance for MDF. Rough allocation for the $35k per market:
- Venue & A/V: $12k
- Local staffing & travel: $8k
- Demand gen ads (social + programmatic): $7k
- Catering & attendee materials: $3k
- Contingency & sponsor swag: $5k

We can commit to 48-hour lead handoff and weekly lead sync calls for the first 30 days. The 60/40 split for the first market is acceptable; we prefer 50/50 on the second two markets.

On recordings: Redwood will own the recording; ScaleForge gets co-branded rights and a copy for nurture sequences. We'll supply an email template and landing page copy; your team can iterate.

If ScaleForge can confirm final dates by next Tuesday (Mar 24), we'll route a short DocuSign for MDF and book travel.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

- SF: Webinar Apr 28 (Wed) / Pop-up demo May 6 (Thu)
- NYC: Webinar May 19 (Tue) / Pop-up demo May 27 (Wed)
- Chicago: Webinar Jun 9 (Wed) / Pop-up demo Jun 17 (Thu)

Thanks everyone — alignment summary and action items below: 

Alignment:
- Program approved in principle: 3 webinars + 3 pop-ups (SF/NYC/Chicago).
- MDF: Redwood proposes $35k per market; ScaleForge proposes 60/40 split for SF, 50/50 for NYC & Chi — agreed in principle per Ben.
- Lead handoff: Redwood commits to 48-hour MQL transfer and weekly lead reviews for 30 days.
- Recordings: Redwood owns master recording, ScaleForge receives co-branded copies.
- Staffing & logistics: Jonas' staffing template and Sarah's checklist captured. Booth load-in window and pass counts noted.

Action items (owners / due dates):
1) ScaleForge to confirm final funding split and sign DocuSign for SF MDF by Wed, Mar 24 — Owner: Sarah Mills. (DocuSign link in Related Links)
2) Redwood to route finalized Draft MDF (with line-item breakdown) and DocuSign — Owner: Ben Carter — Due Tue, Mar 23.
3) Ops to reserve venues and create calendar invites — Owner: Jonas Weber / Grace O'Connor — Due Fri, Mar 26.
4) Creative: co-branded landing + email templates to be exchanged for review — Owner: Stephanie / ScaleForge demand gen — Due Tue, Apr 6.

I'll follow up after Ben sends the DocuSign link. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if anyone wants to walk through the MDF line items.

Best,
Stephanie
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
